% Basic colors declared by color/xcolor use their natural TeX color models.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \foreach \shade/\x in {
    cyan/0, cyan!50!black/1.25,
    magenta/2.5, magenta!50!black/3.75,
    yellow/5, yellow!50!black/6.25,
    olive/7.5, olive!50!black/8.75
  } {
    \fill[\shade] (\x,0) rectangle +(1,1);
  }
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
